in_marathi.name: Chameli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Spring
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chameli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chameli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chamara' which means 'elephant' and 'Lila' which means 'play'. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Chameli is revered as the Goddess of Spring and is often depicted as an elephant-headed woman playing the flute. She is believed to bring new life, prosperity and happiness.
